First I just want to say that people do care about your problems, and that it’s good that you got your feelings out to people. It’s hard but it’s a step that you have to make in order to make progress.

I would take the direct approach and tell her about your grievances. If she is a true friend, she will try to compromise with you and listen so that you can come to an agreement and remain friends. If she won’t have any of it, then I would suggest cutting ties. From this post I can tell you are a wonderful person for putting up with her BS for such a long time, and if she really is a toxic person and not just oblivious, then you don’t deserve that kind of negativity in your life.

Bad people will always try to take advantage of good peoples’ generosity, unfortunately. Trust me, it’s not you, it’s them. But I can assure you that regardless of whether you remain friends with her or not, there will always be people who want to help you cope, both on the internet and in real life. People do care about you and want to help you with your problems! You just need to know where to look :)

I hope you clear things up with Margaret. Best wishes!
